address: 62-68 Java Road, North Point, Hong Kong, Hong Kong SAR China
bio: This long-standing champion of Shun Tak cuisine sports traditional fixtures and fittings. Locals and tourists come for dim sum in the morning, while painstakingly prepared Cantonese favourites and Shun Tak specialities are served at lunch and dinner. Besides signatures like crispy fried chicken and Daliang-style scrambled egg white with milk, don’t miss their sugar egg puff doughnuts available at weekend lunchtime only. Hearty portions to share....
